sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域一些举足轻重的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·莫达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容为一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: President Trump has fired the inspector general for the Department of State, whose investigation posed a threat to his administration.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统解雇了美国国务院的督察长，该督察长的调查对他的政府构成了威胁。

sentences.en: Maggie Haberman on the pattern that that reveals.
sentences.zh: 玛吉·哈伯曼将为您解读这背后的规律。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, May 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月19日，星期二。

sentences.en: Maggie, where does the idea of an inspector general come from?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，督察长这个概念是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: So, the idea of inspectors general, who are basically public watchdogs, emerged out of the Watergate era.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上作为公众监督员的督察长这一概念，是从水门事件时期诞生的。

sentences.en: I have never been a quitter.
sentences.zh: 我从来都不是一个轻言放弃的人。

sentences.en: To leave office before my term is completed is abhorrent to every instinct in my body.
sentences.zh: 在任期结束前离职，违背了我身体里的每一个本能。

sentences.en: Richard Nixon resigned in disgrace after abusing his office.
sentences.zh: 理查德·尼克松在滥用职权后在耻辱中辞职。

sentences.en: But as president, I must put the interests of America firSt.
sentences.zh: 但作为总统，我必须把美国的利益放在首位。

sentences.en: Faith in government dipped substantially among the public.
sentences.zh: 公众对政府的信任大幅下降。

sentences.en: By taking this action, I hope that I will have hastened the start of that process of healing, which is so desperately needed in America.
sentences.zh: 通过采取这一行动，我希望能够加速美国极其需要的治愈进程的开始。

sentences.en: And this idea came about of permanent government oversight at each federal agency of the executive branch, and each one would have their own watchdog in place.
sentences.zh: 这个想法催生了行政分支每个联邦机构的永久政府监督机制，每一个机构都会有他们自己的监督员就位。

sentences.en: And they are supposed to do audits of operations.
sentences.zh: 他们本该对运营情况进行审计。

sentences.en: They're investigating reports of waste or fraud or abuse.
sentences.zh: 他们在调查关于浪费、欺诈或滥用职权的报告。

sentences.en: These oversight officers were essentially a bulwark against corruption, a bulwark against the type of abuses that took place during the Nixon era.
sentences.zh: 这些监督官员本质上是反对腐败的堡垒，是反对尼克松时期那种滥用职权行为的堡垒。

sentences.en: So, a kind of internal affairs department inside each agency of the executive branch.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就像是行政分支每个机构内部的一个内部事务部门。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Inside each agency of the executive branch was somebody who people could report tips to.
sentences.zh: 在行政分支的每个机构内部，都有一个人们可以向其举报线索的人。

sentences.en: And the IG could then investigate those and decide whether those were substantiated or not substantiated.
sentences.zh: 然后，督察长可以对这些线索进行调查，并决定这些举报是否属实。

sentences.en: And if they decide that there is something real there, they would immediately notify Congress within a week, within seven days.
sentences.zh: 如果他们认定其中确有其事，他们就会在一个星期内——也就是七天内——立即通知国会。

sentences.en: And so, there is supposed to be this chain of accountability that exists with the IGs.
sentences.zh: 因此，督察长之间本应存在这样一条问责链。

sentences.en: And the final chain is Congress, so an entirely different branch of government.
sentences.zh: 而这条链条的最终环节是国会，也就是政府中一个完全不同的分支。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And how are these inspectors general regarded after this law is passed?
sentences.zh: 这项法律通过后，这些督察长是如何被看待的？

sentences.en: They are very respected.
sentences.zh: 他们备受尊敬。

sentences.en: What was originally 12 inspectors general expanded and became dozens and dozens across the executive branch.
sentences.zh: 最初的12名督察长不断扩编，最终在整个行政分支中达到了数十人。

sentences.en: And over the years, they have launched investigations into...
sentences.zh: 多年来，他们发起了针对……的调查

sentences.en: Strippers, casinos, Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 脱衣舞娘、赌场、拉斯维加斯。

sentences.en: It sounds like a wild bachelor party, but instead, it's Pentagon employees using their government-issued credit cards.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是一场疯狂的单身派对，但实际上却是五角大楼的员工在使用他们政府发放的信用卡。

sentences.en: Wasteful spending into fraud.
sentences.zh: 对欺诈性挥霍的调查。

sentences.en: A new report by the inspector general at the Department of Homeland Security finds the U.S.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部督察长的一份新报告发现，美国

sentences.en: Citizenship and Immigration Services, or CIS, improperly granted citizenship...
sentences.zh: 公民及移民服务局（简称 CIS）违规授予了公民身份……

sentences.en: Into conflicts of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 针对利益冲突的调查。

sentences.en: Into abuse.
sentences.zh: 针对滥用职权的调查。

sentences.en: The Justice Department released details of a 2004 CIA inspector general's report detailing chilling interrogation techniques, including waterboarding.
sentences.zh: 司法部公布了2004年中央情报局督察长报告的细节，其中详细描述了令人毛骨悚然的审讯技术，包括水刑。

sentences.en: And for the most part, presidents choose not to tangle with them.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，总统们选择不与他们纠缠。

sentences.en: There are some notable exceptions.
sentences.zh: 也有一些著名的例外。

sentences.en: Ronald Reagan, for instance, replaced all of the inspectors general on day one.
sentences.zh: 例如，罗纳德·里根在第一天就替换了所有的督察长。

sentences.en: He said that he wanted a clean slate.
sentences.zh: 他说他想要一个全新的开始。

sentences.en: George W.
sentences.zh: 乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush raised some eyebrows with how he handled a NASA inspector general, for instance.
sentences.zh: 布什在处理美国宇航局督察长的方式上就引起了一些争议。

sentences.en: And then, when we get to 2009, President Obama had been in office for only a handful of months.
sentences.zh: 然后，到了2009年，贝拉克·奥巴马总统上任仅仅几个月。

sentences.en: And at that point, he abruptly fires the inspector general, Gerald Walpin.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他突然解雇了督察长杰拉尔德·瓦尔平。

sentences.en: Barack Obama fired Gerald Walpin.
sentences.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马解雇了杰拉尔德·瓦尔平。

sentences.en: He is the inspector general of the Corporation and National Community Service.
sentences.zh: 他是全国服务公司（Corporation for National Community Service）的督察长。

sentences.en: That is the federal agency responsible for distributing money to organizations like AmeriCorps.
sentences.zh: 那是负责向美国志愿队等组织分发资金的联邦机构。

sentences.en: AmeriCorps.
sentences.zh: 美国志愿队。

sentences.en: Who was overseeing investigations into AmeriCorps and other national service programs and how money was being spent on them.
sentences.zh: 他当时负责监督针对美国志愿队和其他国家服务计划以及资金使用情况的调查。

sentences.en: He was investigating a close political pal of President Obama's, but...
sentences.zh: 他当时正在调查奥巴马总统的一个亲密政治盟友，但是……

sentences.en: And one of the people who Walpin was investigating was the Sacramento mayor and a former NBA basketball star, Kevin Johnson.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔平调查的对象之一是萨克拉门托市长、前NBA篮球明星凯文·约翰逊。

sentences.en: He was an Obama supporter,
sentences.zh: 他是奥巴马的支持者，

sentences.en: and the fact that there was a connection between the president and this person who was connected to one of the groups that Walpin was looking at raised a lot of eyebrows.
sentences.zh: 总统与这个和瓦尔平调查的其中一个群体有关联的人之间存在联系，这一事实引发了许多质疑。

sentences.en: Well, actually, I was fired because I was doing my job and doing it well in supporting my staff who are...
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上，我被解雇是因为我在履行职责，而且做得很好，并且在支持我的员工，他们……

sentences.en: And President Obama alerted Congress that he had lost confidence in Walpin and was going to remove him from that position.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统向国会发出警示，称他对瓦尔平失去了信任，并打算将他撤职。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And did he say why he lost confidence?
sentences.zh: 他有说明为什么失去信任吗？

sentences.en: He did not get into why he had lost confidence.
sentences.zh: 他没有深入说明自己为什么失去信任。

sentences.en: He didn't really offer any full explanation.
sentences.zh: 他并没有真正给出任何充分的解释。

sentences.en: What we have here is a bigger problem with inspector generals that we've got to watch this administration on.
sentences.zh: 我们现在面临的是关于督察长的一个更大的问题，我们必须在这届政府身上密切关注这一点。

sentences.en: And at the time, Chuck Grassley, the Republican senator from Iowa, who has been very, very assiduous in his support for the IGs, was disturbed by what took place.
sentences.zh: 当时，来自艾奥瓦州的共和党参议员查克·格拉斯利一直非常坚定地支持督察长，他对发生的事情感到不安。

sentences.en: And I use inspector generals tremendously in my oversight work, so I'm going to fight hard to make sure they maintain their independence.
sentences.zh: 我在监督工作极其依赖督察长，所以我将全力抗争，以确保他们保持独立性。

sentences.en: He said at the time that he thought it looked as if Walpin had been doing a good job, that he had identified a lot of money in America funds that had not been used properly.
sentences.zh: 他当时表示，他认为瓦尔平似乎一直做得很好，他已经查出了美国基金中大量未被妥善使用的资金。

sentences.en: The criticism of this move by Obama, it should be remembered, was not just Republicans.
sentences.zh: 应当指出，对奥巴马这一举动的批评不仅来自共和党人。

sentences.en: Claire McCaskill, senator from Missouri, who was an Obama supporter, was very critical of Walpin's firing at the time.
sentences.zh: 来自密苏里州的民主党参议员克莱尔·麦卡斯基尔曾是奥巴马的支持者，她当时对解雇瓦尔平提出了严厉批评。

sentences.en: And this was the last time that Obama did this.
sentences.zh: 这也是奥巴马最后一次这样做。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, lesson learned.
sentences.zh: 所以，吸取教训了。

sentences.en: Don't mess with inspector generals.
sentences.zh: 不要招惹督察长。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or lesson certainly appeared to him and learned.
sentences.zh: 或者说他显然懂得了并吸取了这个教训。

sentences.en: It was a hot stove that he touched, and he never touched it again.
sentences.zh: 就像摸了烫手山芋一样，他再也没有碰过。

sentences.en: But from there, we got to President Trump, who, throughout his term, has been extremely skeptical of inspectors general.
sentences.zh: 但从那以后，我们迎来了特朗普总统，他在整个任期内对督察长一直极其怀疑。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: He's a business guy, Michael.
sentences.zh: 他是个商人，迈克尔。

sentences.en: He has never been in government before.
sentences.zh: 他以前从未在政府任职。

sentences.en: And the idea of having this in-house adversarial relationship, somebody who works for him, but who is there to tell him if he's doing things wrong,
sentences.zh: 这种内部对抗的关系——有个人虽然为他工作，但存在的目的就是指出他哪里做错了——

sentences.en: is just a concept that's anathema to him.
sentences.zh: 对他来说简直是一个格格不入的概念。

sentences.en: And so he has chafed at it and has found it uncomfortable, to put it mildly.
sentences.zh: 因此，他对此感到恼火，往轻了说，他觉得这很不舒服。

sentences.en: And then when they have started to do things that upset him, he becomes very angry.
sentences.zh: 而当他们开始做一些让他心烦的事情时，他便勃然大怒。

sentences.en: And that is what has led us to this unprecedented moment of, in the last two months, the president waging open war on the inspectors general.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们走到这个前所未有时刻的原因：在过去的两个月里，总统对督察长发动了公开战争。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请立即下载时报应用，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Maggie, tell us about this unprecedented war that President Trump is waging on these inspectors general.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，给我们讲讲特朗普总统对这些督察长发动的这场前所未有的战争吧。

sentences.en: So there have been four inspectors general who he has targeted.
sentences.zh: 他锁定的督察长一共有四位。

sentences.en: And in each case, he has felt some level of threat from each of them, it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 而且在每一种情况下，他似乎都从每个人身上感受到了某种程度的威胁。

sentences.en: Michael Atkinson was the first one.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·阿特金森是第一个。

sentences.en: And what's important about Atkinson is he is the person who received a whistleblower complaint from an official in the intelligence community who was detailed to the White House.
sentences.zh: 关于阿特金森，重要的一点是，他收到了一名被借调到白宫的情报界官员的举报信。

sentences.en: And this complaint accused the president of an abuse of power related to foreign policy to force Ukraine's government into announcing investigations related to Joe Biden and his son that could have personal political benefit for the president.
sentences.zh: 这封举报信指控总统在外交政策上滥用职权，迫使乌克兰政府宣布对乔·拜登及其儿子展开调查，这可能会为总统带来个人的政治利益。

sentences.en: Atkinson found that complaint to be credible enough to have raised a quote unquote urgent concern.
sentences.zh: 阿特金森认为该举报信具有足够的信誉，构成了所谓的“紧急关切”。

sentences.en: And it, under that label, had to be disclosed to Congress.
sentences.zh: 根据这一定性，它必须向国会披露。

sentences.en: And this report from Atkinson is what triggered the impeachment inquiry into the president.
sentences.zh: 正是阿特金森的这份报告引发了针对总统的弹劾调查。

sentences.en: The president, last fall, before there were actual hearings related to the impeachment, but while Congress was starting to look at this,
sentences.zh: 去年秋天，在与弹劾相关的实质性听证会召开之前，也就是国会开始调查此事的时候，

sentences.en: the president talked to his advisers about firing Michael Atkinson at the time.
sentences.zh: 总统曾与他的顾问们讨论过当时就解雇迈克尔·阿特金森的事宜。

sentences.en: The president's advisers told him this was a really bad idea.
sentences.zh: 总统的顾问告诉他，这是一个非常糟糕的主意。

sentences.en: That if he did this, he was just throwing gasoline on an existing fire.
sentences.zh: 如果他这样做，简直就是在已经燃烧的大火上浇油。

sentences.en: So he waited.
sentences.zh: 所以他等待了。

sentences.en: And the president was acquitted in the Senate impeachment trial on February 5th.
sentences.zh: 2月5日，总统在参议院弹劾审判中被判无罪。

sentences.en: And he dismissed Atkinson a handful of weeks later.
sentences.zh: 几周后，他解雇了阿特金森。

sentences.en: And what does the president say when he fires Atkinson?
sentences.zh: 总统在解雇阿特金森时是怎么说的？

sentences.en: Does he acknowledge that it appears to be an act of retribution for Atkinson's role in the impeachment?
sentences.zh: 他是否承认这似乎是对阿特金森在弹劾中所起作用的报复行为？

sentences.en: No, the president does not acknowledge that at all.
sentences.zh: 没有，总统根本没有承认这一点。

sentences.en: I thought he did a terrible job.
sentences.zh: 我认为他干得糟透了。

sentences.en: Absolutely terrible.
sentences.zh: 简直糟透了。

sentences.en: He says that he's lost confidence in Atkinson.
sentences.zh: 他说他对阿特金森失去了信心。

sentences.en: And he says this in a letter to Congress.
sentences.zh: 他在致国会的信中这样写道。

sentences.en: He took a whistleblower report, which turned out to be a fake report.
sentences.zh: 他拿着一份举报信，结果证明那是一份假报告。

sentences.en: It was fake.
sentences.zh: 那是假的。

sentences.en: It was totally wrong.
sentences.zh: 完全是错的。

sentences.en: It was about my conversation with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 那是关于我和乌克兰总统的通话。

sentences.en: He took a fake report and he brought it to Congress.
sentences.zh: 他拿着一份假报告交给了国会。

sentences.en: That was as much of a reason as Congress was given.
sentences.zh: 这就是国会得到的全部理由。

sentences.en: That man is a disgrace to our Jews.
sentences.zh: 那个人是我们犹太人的耻辱。

sentences.en: All right, let's go next.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们继续。

sentences.en: And I guess as much of a reason as the president needed to give Congress.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是总统需要给国会的全部理由了。

sentences.en: All that he needed to say and the way that he described it in his letter to Congress was,
sentences.zh: 他在致国会的信中所需要说的一切以及他的描述方式是：

sentences.en: as is the case with regard to other positions where I, as president, have the power of appointment
sentences.zh: 正如我在作为总统拥有经参议院建议和同意进行任命的权力的其他职位上一样，

sentences.en: by and with the advice and consent of the Senate, it is vital that I have the fullest confidence in the appointees serving as inspectors general.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，我对担任督察长的被任命者必须具有最充分的信任。

sentences.en: That is no longer the case with regard to this inspector general.
sentences.zh: 对于这位督察长而言，情况已不再如此。

sentences.en: That's as much as they got.
sentences.zh: 他们得到的就只有这么多。

sentences.en: And Maggie, what is the reaction in Congress, and I guess beyond Congress, to this firing of this inspector general?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，国会以及国会以外的人对解雇这位督察长有什么反应？

sentences.en: There was a large outcry.
sentences.zh: 引发了强烈的抗议。

sentences.en: We're in the middle of a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于大流行之中。

sentences.en: And what is this president doing?
sentences.zh: 这位总统在干什么？

sentences.en: As thousands of people are dying, he is retaliating against people that are on his enemies list and doing it in the dead of night.
sentences.zh: 正当成千上万的人濒临死亡时，他却在夜深人静时对他的敌人名单上的人实施报复。

sentences.en: Listen, he got fired for political reasons.
sentences.zh: 听着，他是因为政治原因被解雇的。

sentences.en: He got fired because the president believes that a deep state exists, a group of civil servants that are out to get him.
sentences.zh: 他被解雇是因为总统相信深层政府的存在，相信有一群公务员蓄意要搞垮他。

sentences.en: That is not true.
sentences.zh: 这不是真的。

sentences.en: Democrats and even some Republicans said they were enormously troubled by what appeared to be an act of political retribution.
sentences.zh: 民主党人甚至一些共和党人都表示，这起看似政治报复的事件让他们感到无比困扰。

sentences.en: But there was no consequence for this president.
sentences.zh: 但这位总统没有受到任何后果。

sentences.en: He's right.
sentences.zh: 他是对的。

sentences.en: It's within his power of appointment as president.
sentences.zh: 这在他的总统任命权范围之内。

sentences.en: So he did it again a couple weeks later with another IG.
sentences.zh: 所以在几周后，他又对另一位督察长如法炮制。

sentences.en: And who is the second inspector general who was targeted by the president?
sentences.zh: 第二位成为总统目标督察长的是谁？

sentences.en: Next up was Glenn Fine, who had been the acting inspector general for the Department of Defense since prior to President Trump took office.
sentences.zh: 接下来的目标是格伦·芬恩，他在特朗普总统上台之前就一直担任国防部代理督察长。

sentences.en: Now, Michael, what was notable about Fine was that he was about to become the chairman
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，关于芬恩，值得注意的是他即将成为主席

sentences.en: of a new committee that was going to do oversight on the spending in response to the coronavirus pandemic.
sentences.zh: 新成立的一个委员会将对冠状病毒大流行相关的支出进行监督。

sentences.en: This was going to be oversight of $2.2 trillion in coronavirus relief.
sentences.zh: 这将是对2.2万亿美元冠状病毒救助资金的监督。

sentences.en: So he was going to make sure that money was being properly spent.
sentences.zh: 因此，他要确保这些资金得到妥善使用。

sentences.en: He was going to account for it.
sentences.zh: 他要对此负责。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Fine was going to be the watchdog for this massive amount of government spending.
sentences.zh: 芬恩将成为这笔巨额政府支出的监督员。

sentences.en: The president abruptly moved him out of his office, and therefore he couldn't be the chairman of that committee.
sentences.zh: 总统突然将他调离了办公室，因此他无法担任该委员会的主席。

sentences.en: It seemed as if the president wanted to move out somebody who didn't report directly to him or who was not promoted by him and not handpicked by him in the first place, that
sentences.zh: 总统似乎想调走那些不直接向他汇报、不是由他提拔、也不是最初由他亲自挑选的人，

sentences.en: he wanted somebody who more fit that bill to sit on that committee that would be overseeing the spending of this $2.2 trillion.
sentences.zh: 他希望找一个更符合条件的人来加入那个监督2.2万亿美元支出的委员会。

sentences.en: Next on the list was the principal deputy inspector for the Department of Health and Human Services,
sentences.zh: 名单上的下一个是卫生与公众服务部的首席副督察长，

sentences.en: Christy Grimm.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂·格里姆。

sentences.en: She had done a report that was based on a number of interviews with hospitals all over
sentences.zh: 她做了一份报告，该报告基于对全国各地许多医院的采访，

sentences.en: the country, and those pinpointed massive shortages of supplies at various medical centers, efforts
sentences.zh: 这些采访指出了各个医疗中心物资严重短缺的情况，以及

sentences.en: and struggles to obtain test kits, gear for hospital workers, ventilators that we've heard so much about since.
sentences.zh: 获取测试盒、医护人员装备以及我们后来经常听说的呼吸机的努力和挣扎。

sentences.en: So despite the nearly 1.8 million tests that you say the United States has done, the inspector
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管正如你所说美国已经进行了近180万次检测，但卫生与公众服务部的

sentences.en: general for the Department of Health and Human Services released a report today, a survey of more than $300.
sentences.zh: 督察长今天发布了一份报告，对300多家机构进行了调查。

sentences.en: The president was really unhappy about this report.
sentences.zh: 总统对这份报告非常不满。

sentences.en: What he said to reporters at the time was, it's just wrong.
sentences.zh: 他当时对记者说，这是完全错误的。

sentences.en: I mean, a week or longer.
sentences.zh: 我是说，一周或更久以前。

sentences.en: Did I hear the word inspector general?
sentences.zh: 我听到“督察长”这个词了吗？

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: It's wrong.
sentences.zh: 这是错的。

sentences.en: And they'll talk to you about it.
sentences.zh: 他们会跟你谈这件事的。

sentences.en: It's wrong.
sentences.zh: 这是错的。

sentences.en: Then he asked about who had written the report.
sentences.zh: 然后他问是谁写了这份报告。

sentences.en: It's, well, where did he come from, the inspector general?
sentences.zh: 那个督察长，他究竟是从哪儿来的？

sentences.en: What's his name?
sentences.zh: 他叫什么名字？

sentences.en: It came from the inspector general report.
sentences.zh: 这是来自督察长的报告。

sentences.en: What's his name?
sentences.zh: 他叫什么名字？

sentences.en: I don't know his name.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他的名字。

sentences.en: Well, find me his name.
sentences.zh: 好吧，帮我查查他的名字。

sentences.en: Let me know, OK?
sentences.zh: 让我知道，好吗？

sentences.en: If you find me his name, I'd appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 如果你能帮我找到他的名字，我将不胜感激。

sentences.en: But, sir...
sentences.zh: 但是，长官……

sentences.en: He's asking reporters for the name of the inspector general who has done something that has upset him.
sentences.zh: 他在向记者询问那位做出了令他不安的事情的督察长的名字。

sentences.en: He was asking reporters to figure out for him, and he was assuming it was a male, it was a woman who had written this report.
sentences.zh: 他让记者帮他查清楚，而且他以为写这份报告的是个男的，结果是个女的。

sentences.en: Three weeks after Christy Grimm wrote this report, President Trump announced her replacement.
sentences.zh: 在克里斯蒂·格里姆写完这份报告三周后，特朗普总统宣布了她的接替人选。

sentences.en: OK, so that brings us, I believe, to Inspector General No.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想这让我们想到了第四号督察长。

sentences.en: What is the story there?
sentences.zh: 那里的故事是怎样的？

sentences.en: Inspector General No.
sentences.zh: 第四号督察长，

sentences.en: 4, Steve Linick, had, according to Democratic congressional aides, opened up an inquiry into Secretary of State Mike Pompeo and his wife, and whether they were
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·林尼克，根据民主党国会助理的说法，对国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥及其妻子展开了调查，看他们是否

sentences.en: misusing a political appointee at the State Department to serve them, essentially, to perform menial duties like walking their dog, making restaurant reservations, picking up
sentences.zh: 滥用了国务院的一名政治任命官员来为他们服务，本质上是让他们做一些杂务，比如遛狗、预订餐厅、取

sentences.en: dry cleaning.
sentences.zh: 干洗衣服。

sentences.en: And at the same time, Linick had been looking into and was close to finishing an investigation
sentences.zh: 与此同时，林尼克一直在调查并且快要完成一项调查，

sentences.en: into Pompeo's decision to go around Congress with an emergency declaration to approve billions of dollars in arms sales to Saudi Arabia last year.
sentences.zh: 关于蓬佩奥去年决定绕过国会，通过紧急宣言批准向沙特阿拉伯出售数十亿美元武器的决定。

sentences.en: There was an enormous outcry in Congress that this did not go through approval by congressional officials at the time.
sentences.zh: 国会对此强烈抗议，认为当时没有通过国会官员的批准。

sentences.en: And Linick was looking into this.
sentences.zh: 而林尼克正在调查此事。

sentences.en: So the issue here is whether or not the State Department kind of created a false sense of urgency around approving an arms sale to the Saudi Arabian government.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的问题是，国务院是否在批准向沙特阿拉伯政府出售武器时制造了一种虚假的紧迫感。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And that report, as I said, was close to completion.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，那份报告已经接近完成。

sentences.en: So these two investigations were going on, and we are told that Mike Pompeo told the president that he thought that Linick should be fired.
sentences.zh: 因此，这两项调查正在进行中，据我们所知，迈克·蓬佩奥告诉总统，他认为应该解雇林尼克。

sentences.en: So on Friday, that's exactly what happened.
sentences.zh: 所以在周五，事情就这样发生了。

sentences.en: Another late Friday night ousting of an Inspector General, Linick was announced as departed.
sentences.zh: 又是一个周五深夜罢免督察长的消息，林尼克被宣布离职。

sentences.en: What has been the reaction to this firing?
sentences.zh: 各方对这次解雇有什么反应？

sentences.en: Democrats are very upset about this.
sentences.zh: 民主党人对此非常愤怒。

sentences.en: We need to know why an Inspector General, all of a sudden, gets sacked on a Friday night, added to the three other IGs that have been sacked.
sentences.zh: 我们需要知道为什么一个督察长突然在周五晚上被解职，这已经是被解职的第四个IG了。

sentences.en: The fact is, if it looks like it's in retaliation for something that the Inspector General is doing, that could be unlawful.
sentences.zh: 事实是，如果这看起来像是因为督察长正在做的事情而进行的报复，那可能是违法的。

sentences.en: But given what's happening with coronavirus, given that the attention of the country is largely on either the deaths caused by the virus or the economic devastation
sentences.zh: 但鉴于冠状病毒疫情的发展，鉴于全国的注意力主要集中在病毒造成的死亡或是应对病毒所带来的经济破坏上，

sentences.en: caused by the response to dealing with the virus,
sentences.zh: 这并没有像在任何其他时刻那样引发强烈反响。

sentences.en: this has not broken through in the way that it might in any other moment in time.
sentences.zh: 这并没有像在任何其他时刻那样引发强烈反响。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: How are Republicans reacting to this ouster?
sentences.zh: 共和党人对这次罢免有什么反应？

sentences.en: With the exception of some concern from Chuck Grassley, who's been consistent about Inspectors
sentences.zh: 除了查克·格拉斯利（他一直对督察长保持一致态度）和米特·罗姆尼（他对此强烈批评，并且是唯一投赞成票支持弹劾特朗普总统的共和党人）表达了一些担忧之外，

sentences.en: General, and Mitt Romney, who was very critical and who was the only Republican vote in favor
sentences.zh: 关于此事，共和党人集体保持沉默。

sentences.en: of impeachment against President Trump, there has been radio silence from Republicans on this.
sentences.zh: 关于此事，共和党人集体保持沉默。

sentences.en: It feels like the events of the past few months reveal a pretty central flaw in the original creation of the Inspector General,
sentences.zh: 感觉过去几个月的事件暴露出当初设立督察长制度的一个核心缺陷，

sentences.en: which is that it allows the president to fire these independent figures, right?
sentences.zh: 也就是它允许总统解雇这些独立的官员，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, it's interesting that it was created in the aftermath of Watergate as a check against bad actions in government, and yet Watergate was all about a president being abusive,
sentences.zh: 我是说，有趣的是，它是在水门事件之后设立的，作为对政府不良行为的一种制衡，然而水门事件的核心正是关于总统滥用权力，

sentences.en: and here you have a law that allows a president to fire those internal watchdogs.
sentences.zh: 而这里你却有一部法律，允许总统解雇这些内部监督员。

sentences.en: Michael, I think you've identified the exact problem with this law, which is that it's only as good as the honor system around it.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我认为你指出了这项法律的核心问题，那就是它只有在围绕它的荣誉系统运转良好时才有用。

sentences.en: Because if it's just another piece of the president's power, if the president isn't going to abide by what these Inspectors General find and let them do their investigations,
sentences.zh: 因为如果这只是总统权力的又一部分，如果总统不打算遵守这些督察长的调查结果并让他们进行调查，

sentences.en: then it's not worth very much.
sentences.zh: 那么它就没什么价值了。

sentences.en: So the political consequences of the president are, at this point, uncertain for removing these Inspector Generals.
sentences.zh: 因此，就目前而言，撤换这些督察长对总统造成的政治后果尚不确定。

sentences.en: But I'm curious what you think the consequences are for the Inspector Generals who remain throughout the executive branch.
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇你认为这会对整个行政部门留任的督察长们产生什么后果。

sentences.en: I mean, will this affect how they do their job?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这会影响他们开展工作的方式吗？

sentences.en: Michael, I think that we're never going to know for certain, most likely, but I could see scenarios where Inspectors General feel like they can't open an investigation,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我认为我们可能永远无法确切知道，但我能想象到这样一些场景：督察长们觉得自己无法展开调查，

sentences.en: because if they do, it's just going to get shut down.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他们这么做，调查就会被叫停。

sentences.en: Or they get pieces of information and they want additional confirmation before they'll pursue something.
sentences.zh: 或者他们得到了某些线索，在继续追查之前想要获得更多证实。

sentences.en: It could absolutely have a chilling effect on how these folks do their jobs.
sentences.zh: 这绝对会对这些人开展工作产生寒蝉效应。

sentences.en: Have any of these fired or dismissed Inspector General spoken out since they lost their jobs?
sentences.zh: 这些被解雇或免职的督察长中，有人在失去工作后公开表态吗？

sentences.en: There was a really remarkable statement that Michael Atkinson, the dismissed Intelligence Community Inspector General, put out.
sentences.zh: 被解职的情报机构督察长迈克尔·阿特金森发表了一份非常引人注目的声明。

sentences.en: And he defined this as a message he was leaving for, quote,
sentences.zh: 他将此定义为他留下的信息，引述如下：

sentences.en: any government employee or contractor who believes they have learned of or observed unethical, wasteful, or illegal behavior in the federal government.
sentences.zh: “任何认为自己了解或观察到联邦政府内部存在不道德、浪费或违法行为的政府员工或承包商。”

sentences.en: And he had a very dramatic line in it, talking about the significance of his office.
sentences.zh: 他在其中有一句非常戏剧化的话，谈到了他的办公室的重要性。

sentences.en: The American people deserve an honest and effective government.
sentences.zh: 美国人民值得拥有一个诚实且高效的政府。

sentences.en: They are counting on you to use authorized channels to bravely speak up.
sentences.zh: 他们指望你们利用授权渠道勇敢发声。

sentences.en: There is no disgrace in doing so.
sentences.zh: 这样做并不可耻。

sentences.en: And then he goes on to talk about the importance of whistleblower programs and says,
sentences.zh: 接着他谈到了吹哨人计划的重要性，并表示，

sentences.en: please do not allow recent events to silence your voices.
sentences.zh: 请不要让最近的事件让你们的声音沉默。

sentences.en: Maggie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Michael, thank you.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，谢谢你。

sentences.en: On Monday, Secretary of State Mike Pompeo acknowledged in an interview that he had asked President Trump
sentences.zh: 周一，国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥在一次采访中承认，他曾要求特朗普总统

sentences.en: to fire the Inspector General of the State Department, but said that it was not an act of retaliation.
sentences.zh: 解雇国务院督察长，但他表示这不是报复行为。

sentences.en: Democrats remain skeptical.
sentences.zh: 民主党人对此保持怀疑。

sentences.en: House Speaker Nancy Pelosi sent President Trump a letter demanding a detailed explanation for the firing.
sentences.zh: 众议院议长南希·佩洛西向特朗普总统发了一封信，要求对解雇事件作出详细解释。

sentences.en: In the letter, Pelosi called it, quote, part of a pattern of undermining the integrity of the Inspector's general.
sentences.zh: 在信中，佩洛西称其为“破坏督察长诚信惯例的一部分”。

sentences.en: And, therefore, our government.
sentences.zh: 从而也是对我们政府的破坏。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: We must be frank about one of the primary reasons this outbreak spun out of control.
sentences.zh: 我们必须坦诚面对导致这场疫情失控的主要原因之一。

sentences.en: There was a failure by this organization to obtain the information that the world needed.
sentences.zh: 该组织未能获取世界所需的信息。

sentences.en: And that failure cost many lives.
sentences.zh: 而这种失败代价惨重，夺去了许多人的生命。

sentences.en: In a speech at the annual meeting of the World Health Organization, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国

sentences.en: Secretary of Health and Human Services, Alex Azar, pointedly criticized the group, saying it had mishandled the original outbreak of the virus in China
sentences.zh: 卫生与公众服务部长亚历克斯·阿扎在世界卫生组织年度会议的讲话中，尖锐地批评了该组织，称其未能妥善处理中国最初的疫情爆发，

sentences.en: by promoting misinformation from the government there.
sentences.zh: 因为该组织宣传了当地政府的虚假信息。

sentences.en: The status quo is intolerable.
sentences.zh: 现状令人无法忍受。

sentences.en: WHO must change, and it must become far more transparent and far more accountable.
sentences.zh: 世卫组织必须改变，必须变得更加透明、更加负责。

sentences.en: At the meeting, leaders of the World Health Organization said that they would review their response to the pandemic,
sentences.zh: 在会议上，世界卫生组织领导人表示，他们将对自己在应对大流行中的表现进行审查，

sentences.en: something that several member countries, including the U.S., have demanded.
sentences.zh: 这也是包括美国在内的几个成员国一直要求的。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: I've taken it for about a week and a half now, and I'm still here.
sentences.zh: 我已经吃了一个半星期左右了，我这不还好好活着吗。

sentences.en: During a news conference on Monday, President Trump said that he has been taking doses of hydroxychloroquine
sentences.zh: 在周一的新闻发布会上，特朗普总统表示，尽管缺乏有效的证据，但他一直在服用羟氯喹

sentences.en: as a preventative measure against the virus, despite a lack of evidence that it works.
sentences.zh: 作为预防病毒的措施。

sentences.en: Can you explain, sir, though, what is the evidence that it has a preventative effect?
sentences.zh: 阁下，您能解释一下有什么证据表明它具有预防效果吗？

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: You ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Here's my evidence.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的证据。

sentences.en: I get a lot of positive calls about it.
sentences.zh: 我接到了很多关于它的正面电话。

sentences.en: The only negative I've heard was the study where they gave it, was it the VA, where, you know, people that aren't big Trump fans gave it, and we've done the greateSt...
sentences.zh: 我听到的唯一的负面消息就是那项研究，他们把药发给——是退伍军人事务部吗？你知道的，那些不是特朗普狂热粉丝的人给的——而我们已经做了最伟大……

sentences.en: The Times reports that the president's disclosure has alarmed doctors who fear it may encourage Americans to use the drug.
sentences.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，总统的这番披露让医生们感到惊慌，他们担心这可能会鼓励美国人使用这种药物。

sentences.en: The Food and Drug Administration has previously issued a safety warning about the medicine,
sentences.zh: 食品和药物管理局此前曾就该药物发布安全警告，

sentences.en: saying that it can cause serious heart problems and should not be used outside of hospitals or clinical trials.
sentences.zh: 称其可能导致严重的心脏问题，不应在医院或临床试验之外使用。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个紧密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了（选出了）一群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱、有时甚至令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》播客中，我和萨拉·科尼格一起，讲述了那些试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失去控制的人的故事。
